_doc: Agentic-workspace instance: Harvey LAB, fixed evolve set of 120 tasks + pristine held-out 40 (generated deterministically by split_workspace.py from the Harvey LAB checkout pinned in harvey_lab_commit), Claude Opus 4.8 policy, official ReAct toolbelt base harness. S = criteria passed / criteria total over 120 x k trials (about 14,100 criterion verdicts), i.e. per-trial reward = passed/total weighted by total. Paper values: delta = 0.004 (60 criteria of about 14,100), beta0 = 0.10, beta1 = 35.4 (25% tokens per 100 additional criteria), w_s = 0.1 per criterion = 1414 per unit S, w_c = 15 per unit relative cost. Set delta to null to re-estimate it with `calibrate`.
